title: Used Car Price Prediction
description: Regularized regression project predicting used car resale prices with EDA, feature engineering, linear regression, Ridge, and Lasso models.
metric: 0.9217 test R2 score, Analysed 15,915 Used Car Listings Across 23 Features
insights: Vehicle age emerged as the strongest depreciation driver across all regression models.
Usage intensity (km_per_year) and performance efficiency (power_to_weight) were stronger predictors of resale value than raw mileage or engine size alone.
Compared Linear, Ridge, and Lasso models and found feature engineering drove most of the predictive lift.
